problem_text:
A manufacturing enterprise intends to devise a quality improvement strategy to decrease total defect rates across several production lines. Initially, no corrective actions have been implemented.

The characteristics of each production line are as follows:
* For Line 1, defect rate per unit is 2.457, output volume is 204.934.
* For Line 2, defect rate per unit is 2.44, output volume is 260.292.
* For Line 3, defect rate per unit is 1.944, output volume is 86.944.
* For Line 4, defect rate per unit is 2.304, output volume is 220.182.
* For Line 5, defect rate per unit is 1.959, output volume is 57.893.
* For Line 6, defect rate per unit is 0.926, output volume is 287.051.
* For Line 7, defect rate per unit is 2.073, output volume is 77.474.

To mitigate defects, several corrective protocols are available, each characterized by a specific defect reduction efficacy:
* By implementing Protocol1, defects will be reduced by 88%
* By implementing Protocol2, defects will be reduced by 65%
* By implementing Protocol3, defects will be reduced by 78%
* By implementing Protocol4, defects will be reduced by 35%
* By implementing Protocol5, defects will be reduced by 57%
* By implementing Protocol6, defects will be reduced by 28%
* By implementing Protocol7, defects will be reduced by 16%

Applying a corrective protocol to a production line incurs an additional implementation cost per unit of output. The cost structure for all line–protocol combinations is summarized below:

| Line \ Protocol | Protocol1 | Protocol2 | Protocol3 | Protocol4 | Protocol5 | Protocol6 | Protocol7 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Line 1 | 175.835 | 149.809 | 21.833 | 36.236 | 49.395 | 71.759 | 135.823 |
| Line 2 | 109.841 | 69.613 | 42.905 | 183.304 | 75.042 | 77.315 | 156.678 |
| Line 3 | 146.976 | 132.229 | 141.73 | 125.915 | 46.53 | 56.839 | 116.036 |
| Line 4 | 52.725 | 194.853 | 66.547 | 64.911 | 49.383 | 143.948 | 70.238 |
| Line 5 | 76.273 | 187.403 | 161.127 | 61.957 | 33.156 | 138.558 | 82.142 |
| Line 6 | 196.231 | 165.492 | 191.376 | 162.877 | 65.186 | 64.65 | 145.687 |
| Line 7 | 75.809 | 94.051 | 58.724 | 101.025 | 48.393 | 112.33 | 187.275 |

Management must decide how to apply corrective protocols to each production line (lines may adopt multiple protocols concurrently), and note that a line may also remain partially uncorrected if necessary. The strategic objective is to ensure that the total defect quantity is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.548 of the initial defect level, while minimizing the total implementation expenditure.
